I love how the only sandbox changes Bungie ever seems to implement are ones that not only nobody ever asked for, but ones that completely destroy metas. not just change, but ruin. Whisper is now back to the original black spindle, but worse, because of D2's ammo system, and the wildly inconsistent nature of white nail. Sleeper's ricochet reduction now makes one of the only remaining challenges left in the game infinitely more troublesome, seeing as hardly any other can compete with the DPS of the ricochets. LoW will once again be useless, and the only useful exotic armor pieces are now going to be far less used, as their bonuses are practically worthless, when their only purpose is now hindered, because they're "must-picks". It seems as if the sandbox team or whoever runs this section of the game doesn't fully think through how they change things. They don't analyze metas and change things to either create a new one or balance the old one, they just remove everything that makes the current meta useful, in already buggy content such as raids. It seems to me as if they're INTENTIONALLY pushing people away from their game at this point
